notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25110132/e1cec6235d8644ad7424b368c2767100b61a8ea6.png
Hi there!

New update 1.2.0, now Live! And with this update, we cut price 50%

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25110132/2231c193d104aea521fd1febd0e6edb24e7ed278.jpg

In this update:
- We moved the game to the new version of game engine for more smooth and fast rendering.
- Added some new graphic elements, SFX and optimization.
- Fix, in the Class D flying enemy, now speed up and spin up has correctly for it.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25110132/9f120e6b24601db46ecdbfd2d999d0d5e7f92bf1.png
- Fix bugs, in some level ball has not been dead, when it falling down. Now works correctly for all levels.
- Fix some minor lags.

Best Wishes!

notes.title: GROOVY - Patch 1.1 is Live!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25110132/522cdca6470327680e7c09b6ae08d3e79c6571a7.png
Hi there!

Update feature:

1. Added Steam Global Leaderboards.
All players start from zero score.
More stars - more scores. 
More playing time - more scores. 
Play on Master level - more scores. 
Compare your GROOVY score with your Steam friends directly in game main menu!
Write your name and high score in the GROOVY leaderboards!

2. Balance time.
We increase time for collecting three and two stars. 
Achieve two and three star now is be much easy ːsteamhappyː 

Enjoy the new features!
